matrix: Flow: the escalation ladder asks twice, answers in part, then hands off to human support
description: Three unresolved turns in a row: two clarifying questions (the second built on what the first asked), a partial answer with one targeted question, then a handoff to staff with a note. Nothing escalates before the fourth turn.

ComposeOut.reply: Could you please specify how I can help you today?

compose_sees: Ask exactly one short clarifying question about the one thing you still need

ComposeOut.reply: Is this about an order, a plan or a booking?

reply_contains: order, a plan or a booking
compose_sees: Could you please specify how I can help you today?
never ask a question an earlier assistant message already asked

ComposeOut.reply: I can help with orders, plans and bookings but I cannot tell which one you mean. What is the order number or the plan name?

reply_contains: What is the order number or the plan name?
compose_sees: The customer still has no answer after earlier questions
Is this about an order, a plan or a booking?

HandoffOut.reply: I've passed this to a team member who will get back to you shortly.
HandoffOut.staff_note: The customer's messages stayed unclear after two questions and a partial answer. Nothing was resolved.
